factory: Loader receives the same admitted file snapshot and loaded image. Exact unique body hashes are found only at actual LC_FUNCTION_STARTS boundaries. Factory performs no original function call.
observation_context: Main only, actual pinned initialized original application/director with a running scene and no pending transition, actual existing FileUtils instance and exact source vtable/full-path slot; current mapped bodies rechecked.
singleton_initialization: Never calls getInstance, constructor, init, or a lazy getter; reads only the existing storage derived from the pinned source ADRP/ADD.
native_string_contract: Apple std::__1 24-byte/8-aligned string, receiver X0, const string reference X1, nontrivial indirect string result X8. Compile-time ABI guards and bounded host short/long representation check precede calls.
stat_policy: Only exact expected original bundle/root/tutorial paths and actual own Documents/assets paths, including its tutorial0 child, are checked through NOFOLLOW directory descriptors. Only actual Foundation anchor URLs are canonicalized; appended assets/tutorial0/resource children are never resolved through symlinks. Unknown returned paths are neither followed nor statted. Native and canonical spellings of trusted own anchors are compared without publishing them.
report_policy: Fixed role keys and boolean leaves only. No resolved filename, address, device/container path, native object, file content, or account field is returned.
integration: Optional provider for a subsequent reviewed cohort; current frozen component cohort unchanged. Unavailable observation must not stop the original client.
